automatable_note: OPTO models have no BEC; the manual does not say how the throttle signal side is powered on the bench.

entry.confirm_signal: Two short beeps about 2 s after power-up, then a special tone about 5 s later (written as 56712 or a rising tone in the manuals)
steps: Wait about 2000 ms: two short beeps
Wait about 5000 ms more: special tone, programming mode entered

announce.description: After entry the ESC loops through 8 item tones, one after another. Item N is N short beeps for N 1-4 and 1 long beep plus (N-5) short beeps for N 5-9; two long beeps start at N 10. After an item is selected, the value tones play in a loop, value N sounded the same way.

select.description: Item: move the throttle to min within 3000 ms after the wanted item tone.

value_select.description: Value: move the throttle to max while the wanted value tone sounds. The window length is not stated.

skip.description: Leave the throttle unchanged and wait for the next tone.

scheme.confirm_signal: Special tone (written 1515) after a value is stored.
scheme.exit: Item 8 (two long beeps) then throttle to min within 3000 ms; or after a stored value (special tone) throttle to min within 2000 ms; or disconnect the battery.
scheme.reset_to_defaults: Item 7 (1 long + 2 short beeps) selects 'set all to default'.
scheme.description: Throttle at max, then battery on. Two short beeps after about 2 s and a special tone after about 5 s mark programming mode. The ESC loops item tones; throttle to min within 3 s of the wanted item selects it. Value tones then loop; throttle to max on the wanted tone stores it and returns to the item loop.

unknowns: Beep duration in ms is not stated.
Gap between beeps and between tones in ms is not stated.
Window for selecting a value after its tone is not stated (only 'move to max when the tone sounds').
Pause between tone repetitions before the loop restarts is not stated.
Whether the entry hold (2 s then 5 s) has a tolerance is not stated.
Cell count for models with several cells is auto-detected; manual gives no item to set it.
Tone played after item 7 is selected is not described.
Which value tone sequence is used for items with 2 values (whether a third tone is skipped) is not stated.
Spec table of the 2014 edition (Hobbywing_Sensorless_2022-15.pdf) was read as an image; model list taken from it and matches the 2015 edition.
notes: Hobbywing_Sensorless_2022-15.pdf (HW-SM001DUL-20140715) and Hobbywing_FlyFun_HW-SM001DUL.pdf (HW-SM001DUL-20150707) give the same menu and values.
Program example in both manuals: each value tone is followed by about 3 s of waiting (beep, wait 3 s, beep-beep, wait 3 s, beep-beep-beep).
Item names in the 20150707 edition use 'Brake setting Enabled/Disabled' in the feature text and Off/On in the tone table.
